items.title: Wizards announce that Justin Champagnie had surgery to repair a fracture in his right foot, sustained during the first quarter against the Hornets on Monday. Updates on a return timeline to be "provided as appropriate."
items.author: Dan Devine
items.body_excerpt: Wizards announce that Justin Champagnie had surgery to repair a fracture in his right foot, sustained during the first quarter against the Hornets on Monday. Updates on a return timeline to be "provided as appropriate."

items.title: Wizards wing Justin Champagnie underwent surgery today to repair a fracture in his right foot, @theathletic.com has learned. The Wizards are hoping that Champagnie will be able to return by the All-Star break. Champagnie suffered the injury during Monday's game in Charlotte.
items.author: Josh Robbins
